sentence: The median buffer is $22,325, which looks comfortable. If income falls to 55% and spending stays typical, 35% of 4,500 accounts still run out before 6 months. 54% already spend at least 90% of typical money in, so the gap under EI is large even when the balance looks healthy.
detail: Before any shock, 26% already spend more than they take in. Among accounts that still have a monthly gap under EI, the median gap is $3,275. 2% finished at least one day below zero in the last 6 months.
